problem: Phase5.0 requires a tiny stateful reference whose completed writes survive normal service stop/start and whose absence is not confused with failure.
existingInsufficient: Echo is explicitly side-effect-free; agent execution and decision evaluation do not offer record persistence. Repurposing any frozen capability would violate its semantics.
abstraction: Bounded opaque text key/value put/get with explicit found flag, fixed reference quota and normal restart persistence. No search, embeddings, backup, schema migration or product-specific memory API.
providers: Native single-file reference resource (implemented, qualification pending)
Independent external-author file resource (planned; same contract and no product dependency)
consumers: Unchanged public SDK record consumer in service-foundation/reference/services.mjs
alternatives: Do not add stateful semantics to echo; no MemoryV4 dependency or generic storage engine; explicit native service-owned resource rather than modifying frozen Kernel.
security: Existing Host grants enforce capability operations. Native resource ownership belongs to operator topology; no filesystem confinement claim. Permission metadata grants nothing; data never included in diagnostics.
scopes: Application/session; operation grants put/get, neutral permission label example.records. No new grant or scope type.
compatibility: New experimental proposal only; no original definitions/snapshots changed. Admission and separate snapshot require independent parent review and existing Catalog transition.
genericRationale: Opaque bounded records demonstrate state ownership and persistence without encoding future products or implementation technology.
